_source: Frame cut from a stylised 3D-animated series, supplied by the operator 2026-08-25. Third-party content held locally for model evaluation only — the file is gitignored and never redistributed.
_why_thin: Unlike duel-keyframe, we did not author this frame, so there is no generating prompt to check against. Only fields a careful human would not argue about are graded. Everything else is deliberately left to the agreement table and the --show-disagreements list, where a person adjudicates. A truth column padded with contestable calls stops measuring truth.

_ungraded.shot_size: Both figures read close to full-body inside a large environment; 'wide' and 'full' are both defensible. Left to the ordinal near-miss logic instead of asserted.
_ungraded.camera_angle: Reads low, but the two subjects sit at very different heights and neither eyeline anchors it cleanly. This is the single most interesting field to have a human settle.
_ungraded.texture: The house style is painted-texture 3D. 'painterly', '3d-rendered' and 'cel-animated' are each partly right — a genuine vocabulary stress test, and exactly the kind of split worth reading rather than scoring.
_ungraded.genre_register: Stylised animated action; the schema's contracts are written for live action. Expect models to scatter here.
